meta.title: Todo list
meta.description: Adds a todo checklist to the session header. Click the Todo button and a dropdown opens under it: create tasks, check them off, edit and delete them; finished tasks turn grey with a strikethrough. The list is stored as `.todo.md` in the session's project root and, inside a Git work tree, added to Git tracking so collaborators see progress with each commit. A light entry on the blank-session screen opens the same panel, and one click sends the list to the current AI session to analyse unfinished tasks against completed work for conflicts and ordering.
